lance_pursuit.label: Lance pursuit
lance_pursuit.help: If your 'Mech can't walk and no enemy has been in sight for a minute, your lance goes after the nearest one.

restart_pilots.label: Restart pilots
restart_pilots.help: After a Restart, the lance editor deals the same new pilots a new campaign does, not one pilot over and over.

lance_weapons.label: Lance weapons
lance_weapons.help: Your lance's computer-run 'Mechs fire the weapon each choice is meant to fire. Your lance only; enemies fire as in the original.

lance_tactics.label: Lance tactics
lance_tactics.help: Your lance's computer-run 'Mechs count their firepower right when choosing how close to fight. Your lance only; enemies judge as in the original.
